title: Provider-router routing decisions and sessionInventory operations each emit one structured audit event on the fixed allow-list
asA: operator running the runtime-verify suite against the provider router and the sessionInventory surface
iWant: every routing decision and every sessionInventory operation to write one structured event carrying only the allow-list fields
soThat: the audit stream stays free of session material and every refusal has a stable reasonClass

acceptanceCriteria.description: A routing decision that returns a realm record emits exactly one `keycloak.route` event carrying `outcome=verified` and the routed realmSlug; a sessionInventory `list()` emits exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory` event carrying `outcome=verified` and the caller's realmSlug.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller in realm `alpha` and a project-authored routing function that returns the `alpha` realm record
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provider router routes the request and the caller then calls `sessionInventory.list()`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records two events in order: one `keycloak.route` event with `outcome=verified` and `realmSlug=alpha`, then one `keycloak.session_inventory` event with `outcome=verified` and `realmSlug=alpha`; each event's own-property keys are drawn from `{family, outcome, reasonClass, realmSlug, sessionIdPrefix, at}` and no request-content field appears

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sessionInventory operation from an unauthenticated caller emits exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory` event with `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass=unauthenticated`; the operation itself refuses without side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a request with no verified session
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event with `family=keycloak.session_inventory`, `outcome=refused`, and `reasonClass=unauthenticated`; no session record is created, updated, or removed; no cookie or full session id appears in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sessionInventory `revoke(sessionId)` that first refuses on `unknown_session` and then succeeds on a subsequent call for a valid session id emits exactly one refused event and one verified event on the `keycloak.session_inventory` family, in order; the retry itself is not a distinct event.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller who first calls `sessionInventory.revoke(unknownSessionId)` and then calls `sessionInventory.revoke(validSessionId)`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the two calls run in sequence
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly two events in order: one `keycloak.session_inventory` event with `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass=unknown_session`, then one `keycloak.session_inventory` event with `outcome=verified` and the caller's realmSlug; each event carries a `sessionIdPrefix` no longer than eight characters

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sink failure during the emission of a `keycloak.route` event does not mask the underlying routing decision; the mechanism records a `keycloak.audit_sink_failed` warning event and the routing outcome is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a routing decision that returns the `alpha` realm record and an audit sink whose write throws
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provider router emits the routing event
acceptanceCriteria.then: the routing decision returned to the caller is unchanged (the routed realm record or the sentinel `notThisIssuer`); the mechanism records a `keycloak.audit_sink_failed` warning event carrying the realm slug and a reason-class string; no request-content field appears

acceptanceCriteria.description: A `sessionInventory.revoke(sessionId)` call for a valid session id from an authenticated caller in realm `alpha` emits exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory` audit event carrying `outcome=verified`, the caller's realmSlug, and a `sessionIdPrefix` of the revoked session; count is exactly one event per revoke-one invocation.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller in realm `alpha` and a valid non-current sessionId belonging to that caller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are drawn from `{family, outcome, realmSlug, sessionIdPrefix, at}` with `family=keycloak.session_inventory`, `outcome=verified`, and `realmSlug=alpha`; `sessionIdPrefix` is a substring of length no greater than eight characters; no cookie value and no full session id appears in any field; the target session is invalidated on the provider

acceptanceCriteria.description: A `sessionInventory.revokeAllExceptCurrent()` call from an authenticated caller emits exactly one `keycloak.session_inventory` audit event carrying `outcome=verified`, the caller's realmSlug, and a `sessionIdPrefix` for the retained current session; count is exactly one event per revoke-all-except-current invocation, regardless of how many other sessions were invalidated.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller in realm `alpha` with three active sessions (one current, two non-current)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are drawn from `{family, outcome, realmSlug, sessionIdPrefix, at}` with `family=keycloak.session_inventory`, `outcome=verified`, and `realmSlug=alpha`; `sessionIdPrefix` names the retained current session and is a substring of length no greater than eight characters; no cookie value and no full session id appears in any field; the two non-current sessions are invalidated on the provider and the current session remains valid

acceptanceCriteria.description: A repeated `sessionInventory.revoke(sessionId)` for the same session id is idempotent: the first call emits one verified event and invalidates the session, the second call emits one refused event with `reasonClass=unknown_session` (the session has already been invalidated) with no additional side effect; count is exactly one event per revoke call across both invocations.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated caller in realm `alpha` who has just successfully revoked sessionId `S1` (AC-11119-5 result on record)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the caller invokes `sessionInventory.revoke(S1)` a second time
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one additional event whose own-property keys are drawn from `{family, outcome, reasonClass, realmSlug, sessionIdPrefix, at}` with `family=keycloak.session_inventory`, `outcome=refused`, and `reasonClass=unknown_session`; the total count of `keycloak.session_inventory` events across the two revoke calls is exactly two (one verified, one refused); the session state on the provider is unchanged by the second call

description: Applying agent sets: no project-parameterised values on this story; every AC is `fixed`. AC-set sufficiency (7a inline note per blueprint-authoring.md §7a): the credential scenario class is bound by AC-1 (an authenticated caller in a realm records the realm-scoped identity on both the route and the session_inventory event). The permission scenario class is bound by AC-2 (an unauthenticated caller's sessionInventory invocation refuses with `reasonClass=unauthenticated` and no side effect). Interaction coverage: route-decided AC-1, session-listed AC-1, revoke-one AC-5 (AC-3 also observes revoke-one inside a mixed sequence), revoke-all-except-current AC-6, unauthenticated AC-2.
